entities.summary: Sandro Fabio Mareco is an Argentine chess player. He was awarded the title of Grandmaster by FIDE in 2010. Mareco competed in the FIDE World Cup in 2011, 2013, 2015, 2017, 2019 and 2021. He has played for the Argentine national team in the Chess Olympiad since 2012.
